references.text: The goat-hair curtains also have standardized measurements, demonstrating the same principle of uniform measurement for the tabernacle's coverings.
This verse describes the actual execution of the instructions from Exodus 26:2, with exactly the same dimensions for the curtains.
The ark of the covenant also has precise measurements in cubits, showing how all the sanctuary furnishings were made according to exact divine specifications.
The dimensions of the courtyard are also given in cubits, emphasizing the comprehensive architectural plan for the tabernacle.
Solomon's temple also had precise measurements in cubits, continuing the tradition of exact divine specifications for God's dwelling place.
Explains how the curtains with specific measurements are to be joined into two groups to form the structure of the tent.
Describes the fastenings that allow the curtains with their specific measurements to form a cohesive structure.
